chapter: Hampton, Andy Kirk and Charlie Barnet
title: Back to Kirk, then Barnet's contract claim
summary: He returns to Kirk, Barnet claims a contract, McGhee goes back, and quits in Detroit; his horn was stolen.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So Barnet lays off and you go back with Kirk.

'42. So I went back with Andy, and then like I said, Barnet called me and told me he had a contract and I had to fulfill the contract. So I went back with Barnet. But things kind of changed a little bit after that, you know, as far as Barnet and I were concerned. I liked him and everything, but I don't know what... Something happened that wasn't right. It wasn't on account of the color, though; it wasn't nothin' like that. It was just something else that went down wrong.
But he didn't have a contract.
No, he didn't have no contract, and I knew it. But I just wanted... I was tired of playing them Southern beats anyway. So I quit Andy to go back with Barnet.
And then I wanted... Oh yeah, that's right. Paul Cohen and I was in the trumpet section...

Yeah. And something happened where somebody stole my horn. Yeah, we played at a theatre somewhere, and somebody stole my horn. And Paul and I got into something about that. In fact, we... No, that wasn't it.
It was something else. Anyway, I found out that Charlie was coming to Detroit, he was going to play Detroit for two weeks. So I figured I'm at home, I might as well stay there for a while. Which I...
Are you still single at this time?

Yeah, I was still single. And I went to... I quit the band in Detroit, when they were going back to New York, and Paul quit after they got back to New York -- but he was slick enough not to have to pay that transportation, so he let Charlie pay the transportation to New York and then he quit. And I think Charlie hated me for that.
Yeah. But I couldn't help it. I didn't like it, the way the situation was going down. Something went wrong about that, and I don't remember what it was.
